strings.JNR_SWORDS_GREATSWORD_DESCRIPTION: A single-edged greatsword that is tattered and dull.
strings.JNR_SWORDS_GREATSWORD_SKILL_DESCRIPTION: Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks.  Follow up with a <style=cIsUtility>Primary Skill</style> input for an upward strike dealing <style=cIsDamage>750% damage</style>.
strings.JNR_SWORDS_DARKMOON_DESCRIPTION: A <style=cIsUtility>Legendary Armament</style> bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition.
strings.JNR_SWORDS_DARKMOON_SKILL_DESCRIPTION: Raise the sword aloft, bathing it in the light of the dark moon. Temporarily imbues blade with <style=cIsUtility>frost</style> on hit, with charged attacks releasing blasts of moonlight for <style=cIsDamage>250% damage.</style>
